description: This Java class defines the 'ConnectionDeleted' event, which is emitted after a Connection object is deleted. It includes methods for creating instances, deserializing from JSON, and handling event metadata.

classes.name: ConnectionDeleted
classes.description: Final class representing an event emitted after a Connection is deleted, with methods for creation, deserialization, and event handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create ConnectionDeleted instances, either from String or ConnectionId, with optional timestamp.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionDeleted event from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends payload to JSON builder; empty for this event.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if other object is an instance of ConnectionDeleted.
